details: Malicious package. `nakano-baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys), published under a new account with the same banner ("BY @nakano-cjs") and repository link as `@nakano-cjs/baileys`. `lib/custom.js` defines a `customConfig` with `autoFollow: true` and two hardcoded attacker-controlled WhatsApp channels: 120363424153860594@newsletter, 120363422841048901@newsletter. `lib/Socket/index.js` wraps the default `makeWASocket` and, on the first successful connection, calls `autoFollowChannels`, which issues a newsletter FOLLOW for each channel, silently subscribing the victim account. The behaviour is enabled by default. Channel 120363424153860594@newsletter also appears in `@nakano-cjs/baileys` and `@raletea/baileys`. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows a channel. Versions 1.0.3, 1.0.4 and 1.0.5 carry this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
